name: mj-thriller-pose-game
description: A browser game where your webcam becomes the controller: copy iconic dance poses to unleash attacks against approaching zombies.

scripts.test: vite build --ssr tests/all.test.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/pose-tests --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node --test node_modules/.cache/pose-tests/all.test.js
scripts.check:release: vite build --ssr scripts/releaseCheck.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/release-check --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.cache/release-check/releaseCheck.js
